summary: Iteration 17: tested two features, payment notes on weekly bills and busy-zone balancing in auto dispatch, on the backend and the frontend. Backend: the new suite test_bill_notes_balance_dispatch.py passes 12/12, and the full regression run passes 216/216 after two older tests were updated for the new behaviour. Payment notes: marking a bill paid with a missing, empty, whitespace-only or null note returns 400 'Add a payment note' and nothing is saved. A valid note returns 200 and the note is stored trimmed and cut to 200 characters. The current week returns 400 even with a note, and {paid:false} removes the payment. Balancing (drv-1 covers North only; drv-2 and drv-3 cover nothing): the response includes splits [{zone:North, from_id:drv-1, helper_id:drv-2, moved:3}]. The helper has helping=[North], North is not in its fallback list, and every eligible order goes to exactly one route (3+9+6=18). Moved stops sit on the far side of the zone by bearing. With balance:false there are no splits. With DEFAULT coverage, North is now also split by default (drv-1 has 6 open Mission stops plus 6 North). Frontend at 375x667: the payment sheet passes every step (amount CA$8.00; empty note shows pay-confirm-error and saves nothing; cancel, backdrop and X close it with no change; with a note there is a toast and a 'PAID · <note>' pill; MARK UNPAID shows the recorded note and removes the payment). The auto-dispatch checkbox toggles and the request sends balance:false or true. Result lines show '(HELPING WITH NORTH)' and the toast shows '1 BUSY ZONE SPLIT'; with balance off, neither appears. One logic bug was confirmed with a synthetic unit check: splitting the West zone is not contiguous near due west (see rca_of_issue).

minor.issue: The split is not contiguous for the West zone. bearing() uses atan2, which jumps between +pi and -pi at due west. Sorting West stops by raw bearing and moving ordered[-k:] hands the helper a middle slice, while the heavy driver keeps both ends of the wedge. Confirmed with 8 synthetic West stops: kept [s2,s1,s0,s7], moved [s6,s5,s4,s3]. The seeded Sunset stops are all south of due west, so seed data does not trigger it. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:914-933

rca_of_issue: West seam: bearing = atan2(dy, dx·cos lat). Due west is ±pi, so the West wedge covers [3pi/4, pi] ∪ [-pi, -3pi/4]. Sorted ascending, the list runs SW→W(south) and then NW→W(north). Taking the last k stops gives the slice just north of due west, and the heavy driver keeps the SW and NW ends. Repro: in python, import server and call balance_plan({'a':{'West':stops}}, {'a':8,'b':0}) with stops at lng-0.05 and dy in [-0.004..0.005]. Fix: measure the angle from the zone's centre direction (N=pi/2, E=0, S=-pi/2, W=pi), wrapped to (-pi, pi].
